text: In a category, a morphism f: A → B is an isomorphism when there exists g: B → A such that g∘f = id_A and f∘g = id_B.
explanation: True. This is the definition of isomorphism — a two-sided inverse under composition. It is a purely element-free notion; in Set it coincides with being a bijection, but the definition uses only composition and identity morphisms.
